competingProcedure: Require an empty independent TextEdit baseline.

Launch two fresh instances with the same application URL, createsNewApplicationInstance=true, activates=false, addsToRecentItems=false, -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES and standard ascr/noop launch event.
Wait for both actual processes to finish launching; retain PID/launch epoch.
Use a no-document openApplication reference request with createsNewApplicationInstance=false to discover the default receiver.
Construct exactly one aevt/odoc event addressed to the other live owned process serial number, carrying one private fileURL descriptor in keyDirectObject.
Pass that event to openApplication at the same application URL, createsNewApplicationInstance=false.
Observe exact native document URLs for both owned PIDs before cleanup. The configured receiver is not honored in this run.
